output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initial supply is set in the constructor, minting an initial supply of tokens to the owner. The initial supply is in the units of 10^decimals, and can be exploited due to overflow in totalSupply += mintedAmount; balanceOf[target] += mintedAmount; Transfer(0, this, mintedAmount); Transfer(this, target, mintedAmount);.
The mintToken function has a wrong logic vulnerability. The mintedAmount is added to the target's balance without checking if it causes an overflow. This can be exploited due to integer overflow.
